task.question: Who won the 2026 Chevron Championship golf tournament in Houston in April 2026?

answer:
Nelly Korda won the 2026 Chevron Championship golf tournament held in Houston from April 23 to 26, 2026. She finished with a score of -18, securing her second Chevron Championship and third major title overall. This victory also made her the number one player in the world.
